name: Agachamento no squat articulado
prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Create ONE square gym exercise illustration matching reference STYLE only, replace pose and machine entirely. Same athletic adult male short dark hair, sage tank top, dark forest green shorts, cream trainers. Crisp dark outlines and softly shaded flat colors, charcoal machine, cream background and subtle ground shadow. Whole machine and entire athlete with generous clean margins, anatomical two arms two legs. No text, arrows, logos or panels. PLATE-LOADED LEVER SQUAT MACHINE (squat articulado / V-squat), NOT sliding hack squat or Smith. Athlete stands on wide solid platform, shoulders under two padded shoulder yokes, hands holding handles next to shoulders, knees bent into half squat with feet firmly planted, torso supported by small upright back pad.
